tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic launches an open-source vulnerability scanner powered by artificial intelligence, processing 29K scans and identifying 584 advisories. Confirmed by The Hacker News.
Anthropic updates its policies to ban abusive behavior toward Claude, with new rules taking effect November 12. Confirmed by TechSpot.
OpenAI leads a global acquisition wave with 195 verified artificial intelligence mergers and acquisitions, including a single deal valued at 11 billion dollars. Reported by 36Kr.
Artificial intelligence policy faces mounting political and market tension as Wall Street prepares for the 2026 midterms. Confirmed by CNBC.
USA Today network outlets, including the Courier Journal, sue OpenAI. Reported by WKU Public Radio.
Free every hour.
